## AGRD classification

<!-- Required. See CONTRIBUTING.md for definitions. -->

- **Type:** <!-- feature, deepening, lap-marker, refactor -->
  - `feature` = new component not in any blueprint
  - `deepening` = existing component moving to a higher depth (e.g., depth 2 → 3)
  - `lap-marker` = lap boundary (e.g., "start lap 2")
  - `refactor` = no behaviour change, code cleanup
- **Component:** <!-- which package or tier, or "new" -->
- **Build order Step:** <!-- which Step will this be built in? 1, 2, 3, 4, or N/A -->
- **Target depth:** <!-- depth 1 (stub), 2 (happy path), etc. -->
- **Frozen interface affected?** <!-- Yes (requires ADR) / No -->

## Breaking changes
